title: Jacobs' 'personal project hybrids'

tellings.quote: So he described this as personal project hybrids because the grays have been trying to perfect a hybrid

plain: The researcher Tim Alberino says that David Jacobs, a researcher of alien abduction claims, described what he called "personal project hybrids": part-human beings made because "the grays", the small grey aliens of abduction stories, have been trying to perfect a hybrid. Alberino sums this up without naming a source and points to the book Walking Among Us. If true, it would mean abductions are part of a breeding project.
